description: 想定し得る最大規模の高潮浸水想定区域図 [flood and storm surge and coastal flooding] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 宮崎県. 宮崎県内の日向灘沿岸について、想定最大規模を対象とした高潮浸水想定区域のGISデータをダウンロードできます。. Coverage: 宮崎県. The portal files it under the publisher 宮崎県. Its tags are 防災. It offers 2 resource(s) in docx, zip. The portal shows 2024-09-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
